name: Lisa Simpson's Presentation
look: A frame from The Simpsons: Lisa, in her red dress and pearl necklace, stands on a stage holding a sheet of paper beside a large blank projection screen. A spotlight shines on the screen, red curtains frame the stage and audience members' heads fill the bottom edge.
use: Lisa presents a statement as if it were serious research. The blank screen holds the point, usually an unpopular opinion, a hard truth or a nerdy observation that the audience needs to hear.
slots: the fact or opinion being presented (on the screen)
examples: "Five more minutes" has never once meant five minutes
describe: lisa simpson presenting on a stage with a blank screen
